summary: @or-sdk/flows preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an opaque obfuscated payload
details: Package @or-sdk/flows@2.7.10 declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that automatically runs on `npm install`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun (v1.3.13) to a temp directory without hash or signature verification, chmods the extracted binary executable, and then invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped inside the tarball. `math_init.js` is a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) with string-array/hex-obfuscated content and a rotation function (`WV8StW`) shuffling a 500+ entry constant array. Its filename bears no relation to the package's advertised purpose and is not reachable from the Node-facing `main` — it is only executed under the freshly downloaded Bun runtime at install time. setup.mjs itself is authored with obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`,...) and string-property dictionaries, hiding the install-time control flow from review. The alien-runtime fetch is unpinned in integrity, the executed payload is opaque, its filename is a cover story, and the loader script is deliberately obfuscated — the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern for install-time code execution on any host that runs `npm install @or-sdk/flows`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
